scenario: Compile-error policy per LERR.1.1.8 — use declares an unknown dialect. The compiler can prove at compile time (from the dialect registry) that the name is unrecognised. Rejected with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_DIALECT.
rules_ds:
use no_such_dialect

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
